title: Synchronous PIMI — truly parallel spin updates (iCE40 v3)

prior_failures.root_cause: Checkerboard (sequential even/odd) updates with EMA — NOT the PIMI algorithm. Odd spins saw already-updated even spins, breaking parallel independence.
prior_failures.addressed_by: Implemented truly synchronous updates: all spins use s_current from the START of each cycle. J @ s_current computed before any flip decisions.

prior_failures.root_cause: Same checkerboard root cause as Exp 876.

notes: Synchronous PIMI achieves 4.33x sweep reduction vs no-inertia baseline (12.99 → 3 sweeps). The implementation is architecturally correct — all spins read s_current[j] from the SAME snapshot before any flip decisions are committed. However, for this simple N=8 ferromagnetic ring+chord graph, synchronous PIMI matches checkerboard+EMA (both reach 3 sweeps at alpha=0.5) — the 15-25x paper speedup requires harder problems with frustrated constraints where parallel independence actually matters. Synthesis: 126 SB_LUT4 on iCE40 HX8K (well within 250 LUT budget). Place-and-route clean (0 errors, 1 warning).
